lines.en: I inch forward, segment by segment.
I creep along a leaf vein.
My body arches, then stretches.
I crawl along the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 我换到旁边那片叶子上
lines.en: I move onto the next leaf.
I have many feet, all tiny.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸地挪到叶心
lines.en: I inch toward the middle of the leaf.
I crawl to the leaf's underside, where it is cool.
I travel down the stem.
My body is cold as ice.

lines.zh: 我爬到另一片叶的尖端
lines.en: I reach the tip of another leaf.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转身，不掉下去
lines.en: I turn slowly without falling.

lines.zh: 我在雪线边的一片叶上爬
lines.en: I crawl on a leaf near the snowline.
I reach forward, then pull back.

lines.zh: 我一点一点挪过整片叶
lines.en: I work my way across the whole leaf.
I stop and flatten myself.
I lie on a leaf.
A thin frost has formed on the leaf.
Still, I look like a line of ice.
I am chewing a leaf's edge.
I look up at the snow for a while.
My body is like a shard of ice
I press against the vein for warmth.
This leaf will last me a long while.
I undulate once, slowly.
My breathing makes no sound.
I cannot leave the leaf.
It is exactly cold enough here.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的叶
lines.en: Your shadow covers my leaf
I poke my head over the leaf's edge
Keep your fingers off my leaf
I cannot leave it.

lines.zh: 你要把我挪到哪片叶上
lines.en: Which leaf will you move me to
I have nearly eaten this leaf.
Small as I am, you noticed.
The palm of your hand is warm.
I inch a little away.
I do not know what you want.
I curl into a ball.
My body got squashed.
My whole body jolts
I cannot even make a sound.
I uncurl my body bit by bit
I leak a little sap.
I cling tight to the leaf.
I cannot move at all.
I am still clinging to this leaf.
Let there not be a second one.

lines.zh: 我除了叶子什么都不碰
lines.en: I touch nothing but leaves.
That is not mine to eat.
Set it beside me.
I touch nothing else.
Wrong smell; that's not a leaf
Only a freshly picked leaf
Try another leaf.
I did not even lift my head.
I only know this kind.
I have not finished this one.
You touched the leaf.
Half my body slips off the edge
At the first shake I curl tight
Do not shake it, I cannot hold on.
I slipped a little at the edge.
You stepped on the stem.
I cling to the vein to steady myself.
The whole leaf is shivering.
I inch back to the middle of the leaf.
You nearly crushed me.
I am still young; not yet.
First I must become a chrysalis.
I am alone on this leaf.
I haven't grown wings yet
Do not mention that now.
I go back to eating.
I cannot even be bothered to move.
Ask me after I emerge.
I pull my head back in.
I understand none of it.
You have picked me up.
The inside of your hand is warm.
Where are you taking me?
I curl my body into a ring.
My leaf is still on that tree.
I cannot get a grip on you.
Be gentler with your hands.
Away from a leaf I will not last long.
Put me back on the leaf.
I curl up, then loosen
You are too near my leaf.
I have raised my head.
I rear up my front half.
I chewed the holes under this leaf
I will not move over.
Small as I am, I will push.
I draw myself taut.
Touch it again.
My eyes track your fingertip
I hold my front half straighter
I keep my head up.
Move your hand and I curl.
I stand in the middle of the leaf.
Your face is right beside the leaf
My body is growing colder.
I wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 你的气息一下一下吹过来
lines.en: Your breath comes at me in puffs
You should not have touched this leaf.
One more warning.

lines.zh: 我钉在叶脉上一动不动
lines.en: I'm pinned to the vein, not moving
I bumped your finger.
That had almost no force.
I bite and leave only a mark
Your hand drew back.
I lie back down on the leaf.
That is all I have.
I wriggle my body twice.
You laughed, and I do not like it.
Do not touch the leaf again.
I am still catching my breath.
I crawl out from behind the leaf.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上多了一条冰线
lines.en: A line of ice appears on the leaf.
I have found a suitable leaf.
The cold here is just right.

lines.zh: 我从上面的枝上落下来
lines.en: I dropped from the branch above.
First I nibbled the leaf's edge.
This leaf has good sap.
I press myself flat to the leaf.
Snow falls beside me.
I slowly stretch out.
Fire comes near and I shrivel.
The leaf sways and I fall
The rain soaks me soft
The blast shakes me loose.
An arrow grazes the leaf.
Magic numbs my body.
This leaf is eaten through.

lines.zh: 雷打在这棵树上，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I shudder.
The leaf is gone.
